message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll find in most traditional meat lasagna recipes: | Category | Typical Items | |----------|---------------| | **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | | **Sauce** | • Tomato sauce or passata
• Béchamel (white sauce) – made from butter, flour, milk, nutmeg, salt, pepper | | **Meat** | • Ground beef or a mix of beef & pork
• Optional: Italian sausage or pancetta | | **Vegetables** | • Onion, garlic, carrots, celery (for soffritto)
• Optional: spinach, mushrooms, zucchini | | **Cheese** | • Ricotta or cottage cheese
• Mozzarella (shredded or sliced)
• Parmesan or Pecorino Romano (grated) | | **Herbs & Spices** | • Salt, black pepper, oregano, basil, thyme, bay leaf | | **Extras** | • Olive oil or butter for sautéing
• Red wine (optional, for depth in the meat sauce)
• Egg (sometimes mixed into ricotta for binding) | If you’re looking for a vegetarian version, replace the meat with extra vegetables or a plant‑based protein, and keep the rest of the layers the same. Enjoy your cooking!
